summary.en: One to four short serif lines enter one a beat, coloured where they name the run’s colours; a stats line enters part by part; the token bar lights once on the last downbeat.
summary.zh: 一到四行衬线短句一拍一行进来，说到运行里的颜色就用那个颜色；一行统计按段进来；最后一个强拍上词元条亮一次。

fits: The claim of an explainer, every number the run’s own.
notFor: Long claims (over five words a line); claims with no numbers from the run.

intent.en: The claim is stated in the author's voice with every number the run's own, so it reads as a conclusion, not a slogan.
intent.zh: 结论用作者的口吻说出，每个数字都来自这次运行，读起来是结论，不是口号。

content.en: 1–4 lines (≤ 48 chars / 16 字 each, with [[kind|marked]] words), a stats line (≤ 60 / 24 字).
content.zh: 1–4 行（每行 ≤ 48 字符 / 16 字，可用 [[kind|词]] 标色），一行数据（≤ 60 / 24 字）。

fits.zh: 讲解片的结论，每个数字都来自这次运行。

notFor.zh: 长结论（每行超过五个词）；没有运行数字的结论。

en: Markup counts toward the limits; keep each line short.
Chinese has no italic: the subtitle takes the dim colour instead.
zh: 标记也算进字数；每行写短。
中文没有斜体，副标题改用暗色。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
